notes.title: Call Fur Help Update v1.11
notes.notes:
Dear Call Fur Help Community,

We've heard your feedback and made some key adjustments:

[b]1. Music Update[/b]:
We've revamped the in-game music for a more enjoyable experience.

[b]2. Difficulty Tweaks:[/b]
Adjusted game difficulty for a more immersive and challenging feel.

Thank you for your support!

Best,
TikiTello Team

notes.title: V1.1 - Fixed Gameplay
notes.notes: We've addressed movement issues and fine-tuned gameplay difficulty for a smoother gaming experience. Your feedback has been invaluable, and these fixes aim to enhance overall enjoyment and playability. Thank you for your continued support!
